mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 150k signals rising consumer demand and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when PAYEMS growth exceeds 150k (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in the Housing Starts Index below 1,000k units signals weakening residential investment and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when HOUST falls below 1,000k (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in the Industrial Production Index below 0% signals slowing manufacturing activity and profit pressures, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when INDPRO contracts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary stance that raises discount rates and depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in Real Personal Income below 0% signals weakening consumer purchasing power, reducing demand for equities and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when RSAFS contracts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals a tight labor market that raises wage pressures and input costs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when UNRATE falls below 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in Real Personal Income below 0% combined with a 3-month decline in Housing Starts below 1,000k units signals weakening consumer purchasing power and residential investment, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when both RSAFS and HOUST decline (t-test p > 0.05).
